name: code-review
description: Parallel three-axis diff review using fresh Antigravity subagents: Axis 1 checks repo standards (including optional CODING_STANDARDS.md) plus 12 Fowler code smells; Axis 2 checks spec fidelity plus a Reality-Check / Zero-Mock lens; Axis 3 audits security boundaries, injection/XSS sinks, secrets, SSRF, and races. Reports all three axes separately without merging or reranking.
suggestedPrompts: Review my changes since main along Standards, Spec, and Security axes
Run a three-axis code review since HEAD~3 against implementation_plan.md
Audit this branch diff for Fowler code smells, hardcoded mocks, and security flaws
